operator.finding: IONITY first-party support explicitly states that direct charging price can vary by specific station even within the same country. Country/site headline prices are current minimum prices and station price may be higher. Therefore no Italy-wide Direct value may be deterministically applied to all IT*IOY EVSE.
positiveEvidence: IONITY Italian support: direct price depends on tariff, subscription, country and specific station; prices can vary between locations in the same country.
Exact station price is exposed in IONITY app, QR/payment site, or contactless terminal display.
IONITY Direct is ad-hoc with QR/payment site/contactless and is distinct from MSP roaming.
negativePathsExhausted: Treating the country headline/minimum Direct price as an Italy-wide deterministic tariff.
Using IONITY subscription or MSP roaming values as direct CPO tariff.
